info.name: Support Router API
info.description:
LLM-driven customer support router.

1. Import `local.postman_environment.json` as well and select it.
2. Set `apiKey` to the APP_API_KEY in your server's .env.
3. Start the server: `.venv/bin/uvicorn support_router.api:app --port 8000`.

Chat requests save `session_id` into `{{sessionId}}` automatically. Requests marked 'Continues the session' reuse it, so run folders top to bottom.

Running the WHOLE collection with the Runner? The per-user rate limit (20/min + 5 burst) will kick in around request 25. For local testing set `RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE=200` in .env and restart the server, or set a Runner delay of 2500 ms.

item.name: 7. Sessions & long-term memory
item.description: Run in order. Uses {{sessionId}} from the last chat request.

request.description: Starts a NEW session (no session_id). Saves the returned session_id to {{sessionId}}.
Restore a chat after app relaunch. Bot turns include their ui_options.
Closes the chat. A redacted summary is written to long-term memory in the background.
Summaries the assistant remembers about {{userId}} (last 180 days).
Continues the session in {{sessionId}} (run the previous request first). Session was ended, so the server returns new_session=true with a NEW session_id. Memory is now in context.
Privacy: deletes all stored summaries for {{userId}}.
Wrong X-API-Key.
No headers at all.
session_id must be 32 lowercase hex chars.
Same session, different X-User-Id => 404 (not 403, to avoid leaking which IDs exist).
Default limit is 20/min + burst 5 per user. Run this request with the Collection Runner at 30 iterations; later ones return 429 with a Retry-After header.
